definition: to hit something hard and violently
description: A rustic farm-shop kitchen with shelves of jars and crates of fruit. A young man in an apron slams both palms down onto a round of bread dough on a floured table. Then a pair of hands drives a heavy stone pestle down again and again into a mortar full of peppercorns and dried chillies. A woman in denim beats a djembe drum hard with her palms, laughing. Another man swings a heavy rubber mallet down onto the dough, and then pounds the pestle into the mortar with both fists.
